1. Introduction & Project Objectives

1.1 Introduction

In contemporary enterprise computing, professional web systems must marry robust software engineering principles with transparent, auditable version control workflows. Distributed version control using Git and remote collaboration via GitHub have transitioned from operational conveniences to fundamental industry requirements for verifying software reliability, reproducibility, and continuous delivery.

This project, developed under the curriculum of IT4048: Version Control with Git and GitHub at Asha M. Tarsadia Institute of Computer Science and Technology (AMTICS), showcases the design, development, local tracking, semantic commit architecture, and cloud deployment of two robust web platforms unified within the SE-Project repository:

  • BuildPulse CMS: An industrial-grade Enterprise Construction Management System built for civil engineers, site project directors, quantity surveyors, and clients to coordinate multi-site operations, milestone delivery, material supply chains, heavy machinery fleet logistics, and HSE safety remediation.
  • Balaji Medical: A full-stack 24x7 healthcare dispensing and pharmaceutical web application featuring clinical catalog discovery, prescription (Rx) document verification, real-time inventory decrement, and formal GST drug invoice generation.

1.2 Primary Objectives

The core objectives achieved throughout this academic engineering project include:

  • Enterprise Software Engineering: Designing modular, maintainable Python 3.13 application architectures utilizing the Flask WSGI micro-framework, custom template filters, and atomic database queries.
  • Relational Database Integrity & ACID Compliance: Formulating relational schemas with SQLite3, enforcing foreign key constraints, cascading updates, transactional consistency, and automated demonstration seeding across 10 distinct entities.
  • Version Control Mastery (IT4048 Core): Implementing structured Git workflows from local repository initialization, staged change isolation, semantic commit tagging under Conventional Commits specifications, and authenticated cloud synchronization.
  • Independent Multi-Service Runtime: Decoupling the construction management platform and pharmaceutical healthcare services so both systems can execute concurrently on dedicated local ports (5000 and 5001) without resource or database deadlocks.
  • User Interface & Cross-Viewport Responsiveness: Implementing modern UI systems using Tailwind CSS CDN, Lucide vector iconography, and high-contrast color palettes adhering to WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Automated Quality Assurance: Authoring automated unit and integration test suites via Python's unittest framework, achieving 100% pass rates across schema validation, model logic, and HTTP endpoints.

1.3 Technologies Applied

The technology stack was selected to provide maximum architectural modularity, deterministic operational behavior, zero external runtime configuration hurdles, and standard version control traceability:

Technology Layer Specific Tool / Library Purpose & Architectural Role in Project
Backend Runtime Python 3.13 (64-bit) Core server execution environment; provides high computational performance, comprehensive standard libraries, and reliable thread handling.
Web Application Framework Flask 3.1.3 (WSGI) Handles HTTP routing, RESTful request dispatching, session cookies, dynamic URL parameter parsing, and multipart file upload handling.
Templating Engine Jinja2 (HTML5 / XML) Server-side HTML rendering engine providing template inheritance (base.html), custom currency filters ($ / ₹), and dynamic context injection.
Embedded Database SQLite3 Relational Engine Zero-configuration, serverless ACID relational database engines (buildpulse.db and balaji_medical.db) with enforced foreign keys and automated seeding.
Frontend Styling Tailwind CSS (CDN) Utility-first responsive styling framework utilizing custom dark slate (#0f172a) and emerald healthcare (#10b981) design tokens.
Iconography & Typography Lucide Icons & Plus Jakarta Sans Scalable SVG engineering iconography and clean typography loaded via Google Fonts CDN for high legibility across display densities.
Data Analytics & Graphs Chart.js Client-side dynamic charting library visualizing Budget vs. Spend burn rates, project completion velocities, and cost code distribution.
Version Control System Git CLI 2.x Distributed version control engine managing staging indexes, branch isolation, Conventional Commit logs, and repository configuration.
Cloud Synchronization GitHub Cloud Platform Remote repository hosting (adhirajjha587-maker/SE-Project), collaborative code backup, issue tracking, and version milestone auditing.

1.4 Development & Execution Environment

The project operates natively across Windows 11 environments without requiring complex Docker virtualization or manual database daemon configuration. Launch scripts (run_balaji.bat and run_buildpulse.bat) provide immediate 1-click execution:

  • Port 5000: Dedicated to Balaji Medical Healthcare & Pharmacy Platform (REST API & Storefront).
  • Port 5001: Dedicated to BuildPulse Enterprise Construction Management System (Dashboard & Field Portals).

2.2 Functional Modules & Application Features

The system encompasses complete operational workflows designed for field operations and enterprise control:

  • Executive Construction Dashboard (/dashboard): Top-level operational hub calculating real-time Key Performance Indicators across all active job sites: Total Committed Budget ($22.50M), Disbursed Spend ($15.20M), Remaining Working Capital ($7.30M), Active Workforce Headcount (48 tradesmen), Fleet Operational Units (9 machinery assets), Low-Stock Threshold Alerts, and Open HSE Safety Tickets.
  • Project Catalog & Milestone Gantt (/projects & /projects/<id>): Full project lifecycle management tracking project codes (e.g. PRJ-2026-01), client identity, structural project classification (Commercial, Infrastructure, Industrial, Residential), completion velocity percentages, and phased milestone status updates with automated overall progress recalculation.
  • Supply Chain Inventory & Low-Stock Alerts (/materials): Central materials inventory managing structural supplies (OPC 53 Cement, TMT 550D Rebar, M35 Ready-Mix Concrete, M-Sand, AAC Blocks, PVC Conduits, Armored Cable). Features automated safety threshold triggers and purchase requisition lifecycles (Pending → Approved → Delivered) that update stock levels atomically.
  • Heavy Machinery & Fleet Operations (/equipment): Comprehensive machinery registry (Tower Cranes, CAT Excavators, Boom Pumps, Backhoes, Bulldozers, Dump Trucks, Diesel Generators) capturing operational status (In Use, Available, Maintenance), certified operator assignments, total operating hours, and scheduled maintenance dates.
  • Workforce Trades & Subcontractors (/workforce): Direct labor personnel directory categorized by certified engineering and vocational trade (Site Engineers, Foremen, Masons, Carpenters, Electricians, Welders, Crane Operators) with daily wage rates, safety induction validity tags, and specialized subcontractor partner ratings.
  • Daily Field Site Diary (/site-logs): Site supervisor reporting logging daily meteorological conditions (Sunny, Rainy, Overcast), ambient temperature, on-site trade headcount, technical work summaries, and critical roadblock delay tags.
  • HSE Hazard & Incident Ticketing (/safety): Digital safety compliance register tracking hazard severity (Low, Medium, High, Critical) and categories (Fall Hazard, PPE Non-Compliance, Electrical, Scaffolding, Near Miss) with official corrective remediation workflows.
  • Financial Control & Expense Ledgers (/financials): Detailed financial ledger tracking invoice vouchers, expense categorization (Materials, Equipment Rental, Direct Labor, Logistics, Legal Permits), and budget burn rates.
  • Public Client Transparency Portal (/client-portal): External portal where property buyers, municipal auditors, or client stakeholders input their project code (e.g. PRJ-2026-01) to inspect live progress percentages, delivery milestones, and verified field notes.
  • Balaji Medical Pharmacy Storefront (/ on Port 5000): Comprehensive pharmaceutical dispenser with 105+ clinical medicines across 8 therapeutic categories, real-time search, prescription verification workflow, and automated GST invoice calculation.

3. Git & GitHub Version Control Pipeline

3.1 Version Control Methodology (IT4048 Core)

Version control represents the structured discipline of tracking, managing, and collaborating on software codebase modifications over time. For this mini-project, Git CLI version 2.47 was utilized from project conception through incremental staging to final published cloud synchronization.

3.2 Commit History & Conventional Commit Standards

To ensure professional industry auditability, all commits adhere to the Conventional Commits 1.0.0 specification. The repository history reflects atomic, self-documenting milestone evolutions:

Commit SHA Type & Scope Commit Summary & Architectural Modifications Author / Date
ba12859 feat(pharmacy) Add Balaji Medical healthcare and pharmacy store platform; initial schema creation, 105 clinical medicines, and prescription upload engine. Adhiraj Jha
19-Sep-2026
01a1c54 build(deploy) Add requirements.txt and runtime configuration for WSGI deployment environments. Adhiraj Jha
19-Sep-2026
9b90878 feat(construction) Add BuildPulse platform and project updates; implement 10 relational tables, 6 projects, executive KPI calculation, and Chart.js integration. Adhiraj Jha
25-Oct-2026
f3ed3b2 refactor(arch) Configure BuildPulse and Balaji Medical to run side-by-side independently; add dedicated launchers run_balaji.bat and run_buildpulse.bat. Adhiraj Jha
25-Oct-2026

3.3 Cloud Deployment Pipeline (GitHub Remote)

The local repository is synchronized with GitHub Cloud via an authenticated HTTPS pipeline utilizing personal security credentials and Git Credential Manager: 

Local Workspace → Working Tree Filter (.gitignore) → Staging Index (git add .) 
       ↓
Semantic Atomic Commit (git commit -m "...") 
       ↓
Authenticated Push Pipeline (git push -u origin main)
       ↓

3.4 Quality Assurance & Automated Test Results

To validate database schema consistency, foreign key constraints, model calculations, and HTTP route responses, automated test suites were authored using Python's standard unittest framework. All 18 automated tests execute in under 0.8 seconds and achieved a 100% pass rate:

Test ID Feature Verified Test Procedure & Input Condition Observed Expected Result Status
TC-01 Database Connectivity Query sqlite_master for BuildPulse tables. All 10 required relational tables verified present. PASS
TC-02 KPI Calculations Invoke models.get_kpis() across active sites. Total projects > 0, budget metrics computed. PASS
TC-03 Project Code Lookup Query project by unique code PRJ-2026-01. Returns correct project record and client details. PASS
TC-04 Project Insertion & Update Insert project PRJ-TEST-99 and mutate progress. Database transaction commits with verified fields. PASS
TC-05 Milestones Workflow Add milestone and update completion percentage. Average project progress automatically recalculated. PASS
TC-06 Material Requisitions Create requisition and mark status as Delivered. Current material stock decremented atomically. PASS
TC-07 Equipment & Workforce Reassign equipment operator and query directory. Operator assigned; trade records verified valid. PASS
TC-08 Site Diary & Safety Log weather/work summary and report HSE ticket. Log inserted with temperature; safety ticket Open. PASS
TC-09 Financial Ledgers Add project expense voucher of $4,500. Project current_spend incremented by $4,500. PASS
TC-10 HTTP Route Responses Request all 18 Flask endpoints via test client. Every GET and POST route returns HTTP 200 OK. PASS
TC-11 Balaji Medical API Query /api/medicines and category filters. Returns 105 medicines with pricing and dosage forms. PASS
TC-12 Prescription Uploads Upload mock clinical PDF slip to upload endpoint. Generates unique secure filename and saves in storage. PASS
